sourceFile: 81. BRS-161014 DT Report test JIG Frame Array  material sus  date 21.11.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable rows but incorrectly merges distinct JIG validation reports and unreliable outcome grouping.
issues: Multiple sheets/reports collapsed into one changed factor.
Changed factor mixes material SUS, new/old JIG, line, settings, and totals.
Baseline/test pairing ignores date, line, and test-round context.
Spot-welding follow-up omits Normal comparator rows.
Measurement stats use wrong specs and mostly cite header rows.
correctionPlan: Split or separately group 10.9, NG Rate, initial material SUS, and follow-up material SUS contexts.
Define primary factor per report, e.g. material SUS vs Normal where supported.
Preserve date, line, type, setting, and test round as subgroup keys.
Rebuild outcomes with matched comparator rows including Normal totals.
Remove invalid measurement-stat section unless row-level measurements and specs are proven.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but they do not sufficiently support the current grouping or calculations.
